flashing: A sharp startup darkening is predicted; source records one coherent darkening transition with about0.267mean luma drop.

feedback: Older wave material persists and becomes warped, dithered texture rather than being replaced by a clean loop each frame.
Blur-dependent differences change the distortion, producing irregular smearing around the geometric seed.
The point-wrap sampler can recirculate image material near texture boundaries; this is not a strictly isolated central object.
